reviews.title: Maps don’t always load
reviews.text:
Happy to take my £45 for a yearly subscription but then the maps don’t load on iPad or iPhone. 
Is there a fix for this?
If not I might be looking for a refund.

reviews.title: Allows scams in ads
reviews.text:
Beware: this app allows scammers to advertise. Got pop ups saying my phone is “severely damaged” by “72 viruses” with a link to scamware. 

Keep it classy!

reviews.title: Awful!
reviews.text: Now it wants me to run some clean up app before I can use the app. Deleting app!

reviews.title: Allows VERY DODGY Adverts!!!
reviews.text:
This app allows very dodgy adverts including malicious ones that claim things like “your device is hacked” - “go to our website now to clean your device” 
If you see stuff like this pay no attention it’s designed to scare you to make you download their stuff which will ACTUALLY infect your device. Very alarming that the app allows those kinds of ads. Normal ads are annoying but atleast they aren’t malicious.

reviews.title: Awful!
reviews.text: What have you done!?!?! I’d give no stars if I could. Everything I loved about this app is gone.

reviews.title: Advertisement won’t let you past!
reviews.text: You can’t get past the game advertisement. I’m sure there are other apps that will!Deleted!!

reviews.text: When I first downloaded it worked well but since the last update it is a total waste of time. If the developers don’t sort this out they may as well delete it.
